title: Iki workflow (iki/v1)
description: Steps that each run one of the plugin's actions, wired together by what they take and make. Steps run as soon as the steps they take from have succeeded.

name.description: The workflow's name in snake_case. Elsewhere it is `plugin.name`.

inputs.description: The entities it starts from, by name, as an action's inputs.

params.description: The values a person (or an agent) chooses when they start it, by name, as an action's params.

steps.description: Each step, by an ID of its own.

entityRef.description: Where a step's input comes from: the workflow's input (`$inputs.<name>`), what a step was given, once it has run (`$steps.<id>.inputs.<name>`), or the entities of a type a step created (`$steps.<id>.created.<Type>`).

condition.description: A value compared with another: exactly one of `is`, `is_not`, `in`, `at_least`, `at_most`, `above` or `below`.

value.description: The workflow's param (`$params.<name>`), or a metric an earlier step's action declares (`$steps.<id>.metrics.<name>`).

is.description: Equal to this, or to the workflow's param (`$params.<name>`).

is_not.description: Not equal to this, or to the workflow's param.

bound.description: A number, or the workflow's param (`$params.<name>`).

action.description: The name of the plugin's action it runs.

each.description: One of the action's inputs that takes one entity: the step runs once for each entity its source gives, as a batch. Its created entities, and what it was given for this input, are then many.

approval.description: A person approves it before it starts, once the steps it runs after have succeeded and its conditions hold: someone with this role in the project, other than whoever started the workflow. Declining it fails the workflow.

role.description: The project role an approver needs: viewer, editor (the default), runner or admin.

instructions.description: What the approver checks, shown where they decide.

when.description: What must hold for it to run, all of it. Otherwise it's skipped, and so are the steps that take from it.

inputs.description: Where each of the action's inputs comes from, by the input's name.

params.description: The action's params, by name: a value, or the workflow's param (`$params.<name>`). A string starting with `$` is written `$$`. Those left out take their defaults.

needs.description: Steps it runs after, besides those it takes from.
